title: Kiln start progress (<game>/kiln/state/progress.json), format 1
description: Written by kiln-core only (0.2.0-dev.27), on clients and dedicated servers, replaced whole and atomically (<file>.tmp, then a rename): at once at every change of step or state, at most every 250 ms for a change of label, detail or count (the last one is never lost). Services, plugins and Kiln.Host report to the core through kiln.progress v2 (native/core/abi/services/kiln_progress.h). A new process writes a new file from its first step: a reader tells a stale file by pid and started, as for boot.json. After ready, idle or failed the file is not written again in that process; nothing deletes it. A runtime older than dev.27 writes no such file. docs/kiln/launcher/contracts.md.

pid.description: The game process, as boot.json's pid (the Windows pid under Wine and Proton).

kiln.description: Kiln's version with its build stamp ("0.2.0-dev.27+20261113.2e75c1f"); boot.json's kiln is the version without the stamp.

started.description: When Kiln's boot began in this process: RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds.

atMs.description: Milliseconds since started when this file was written; in a final state (ready, idle, failed), when that state began, so that the steps' tookMs add up to it.

state.description: booting: inside Kiln's boot. loading: the boot is complete and the game goes on loading (managed mods load in its first frames on a client). ready: a client's main menu (or first world frame) has drawn with every mod loaded; a server's world runs with the mods loaded (Kiln.Host's ServerStarted; without .NET the server world's first step). idle: safe idle, Kiln hooked nothing (why). failed: Kiln could not go on (why): the boot threw, or the .NET host did not start.

plan.description: Every step this start goes through, in order, known at its start. Without .NET (kiln.json clr off) there is no dotnet, mods or content.

steps.description: Every step begun so far, in the plan's order (none left out between two of them); the last one runs unless it has tookMs. Each step begins when the one before it ends.

why.description: state idle or failed: one sentence (idle: boot.json's safeIdle). null otherwise.

label.description: A short English fragment a player can read, without a full stop. It may change while the step runs (step plugins: "Starting plugins", then "Getting Kiln's services and plugins ready"; step mods: "Waiting for the game to load the mods", then "Loading the mods").

detail.description: What is being worked on right now (a service, plugin, mod or block by the name a player knows). Absent: nothing named.

total.description: With done: the step is a loop over known things, both in the same unit (services: service DLLs; plugins: modules getting ready; early-plugins: early plugins; mods: mods; content: data blocks).

ms.description: When the step began, ms since started.

tookMs.description: What it took, once it ended.

label.description: The same from start to start (a module's name: "ShroudForge", "kiln-vfx: getting ready"); no counts, no times.

parts.description: Named pieces of the step that took 500 ms or more: early-plugins per early plugin; services and plugins per module's start ("<name>: starting") and on_ready ("<name>: getting ready").
